about_the_game:
Welcome to the Magic World Demo

Step into a magical world where every spell requires skill, and every duel is a test of your reflexes and strategy.

What’s included in the demo:

✅ Tutorial Mode – learn the controls and master the unique magic system
✅ Single-player Mode – fight against advanced AI opponents
✅ Multiplayer Mode – challenge your friends to thrilling magical duels
✅ Core Combat Mechanics – experience deep and dynamic spellcasting battles
✅ 10+ Magic Spells – experiment with different combinations and tactics
✅ Battle Arena – prove your strength in intense magical arenas

The demo will be regularly updated
We are using this demo to test and refine the core combat mechanics. Expect:

  • Frequent updates with new spells, improvements, and balance changes

  • Expansion of magical abilities and tactical options

  • Dedicated server support for stable multiplayer matches is already in development

Join the Magic World Demo, experience spellcasting firsthand, and help shape the future of the game with your feedback.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / Intel Arc A750
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
